# FlightDecide

> FlightDecide is an AI-assisted go/no-go preflight decision-support app for
> general aviation pilots (iOS; Android coming soon). It reads live METARs,
> TAFs, winds aloft, SIGMETs, PIREPs, and NOTAMs for the planned flight
> window, computes fuel requirements (14 CFR Part 91 VFR/IFR reserves),
> weight and balance, and takeoff/landing performance from curated POH data,
> then produces a scored GO / CAUTION / NO GO advisory across 8 risk
> categories plus a plain-language AI briefing that pilots can verify
> against the raw data. It is advisory decision support, not an official
> weather briefing; the pilot in command retains final authority (14 CFR
> 91.3). Not for Part 135/121 operations.

Key facts:
- Platform: iPhone (iOS 17+). App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/flightdecide/id6761793626
- Pricing: Free (3 analyses/month), Pilot $9.99/mo (unlimited, custom
  aircraft profiles), Pro $19.99/mo (adds fleet management).
- Weather/NOTAM sources: aviationweather.gov and the FAA NOTAM system
  (government sources only; NAV CANADA data for Canadian coverage).
- NOTAM honesty: FlightDecide distinguishes "queried, zero NOTAMs" from
  "coverage gap"; it never claims "no NOTAMs" without evidence the source
  was queried.
- Aircraft library: trainers through jets (C150/152, C172, PA-28, C182,
  C206, SR22, M20J, A36, Seneca, Baron 58, C310, Meridian, King Air C90,
  PC-12, CJ1+, CJ3, Phenom 100, and more), plus custom profiles with
  personal minimums.

## Free Pilot Tools (browser-based, no sign-up)

A free online E6B flight computer and preflight planning suite: browser-based
flight-planning calculators covering the calculations pilots run before every
flight. No sign-up; everything runs locally.

- [Tools hub](https://flightdecide.com/tools/)
- [Crosswind Calculator](https://flightdecide.com/tools/crosswind-calculator/):
  headwind/crosswind components with gust handling, demonstrated-crosswind
  guidance, clock rule of thumb.
- [Density Altitude Calculator](https://flightdecide.com/tools/density-altitude-calculator/):
  pressure altitude, ISA deviation, and density altitude from field
  elevation, altimeter, and temperature.
- [True Airspeed Calculator](https://flightdecide.com/tools/true-airspeed-calculator/):
  CAS to TAS, Mach, pressure altitude, and density altitude from altitude
  and temperature, with the 2% rule of thumb.
- [Time-Speed-Distance Calculator](https://flightdecide.com/tools/flight-time-calculator/):
  solve flight time, groundspeed, or distance from the other two, plus
  ETA and checkpoint groundspeed-check technique.
- [Fuel Burn & Endurance Calculator](https://flightdecide.com/tools/fuel-burn-calculator/):
  gallons burned, endurance to dry tanks, and margin over the FAA
  reserve, with plan-in-time fuel habits.
- [Wind Correction Angle Calculator](https://flightdecide.com/tools/wind-correction-calculator/):
  the wind triangle: WCA, true/magnetic heading, and groundspeed from
  course, TAS, and winds aloft.
- [Cross-Country Trip Planner](https://flightdecide.com/tools/flight-plan-calculator/):
  multi-leg nav log solver: compass heading, groundspeed, leg time,
  ETA, and fuel per leg plus trip totals, saved locally.
- [Weight & Balance Calculator](https://flightdecide.com/tools/weight-balance-calculator/):
  gross weight, total moment, and CG from itemized loading, envelope
  check against user-entered limits, weight-shift solver.
- [Descent & Glide Calculator](https://flightdecide.com/tools/descent-glide-calculator/):
  top of descent and required rate (3-degree rule) plus still-air
  glide range and time from glide ratio and height.
- [Holding Pattern Entry Calculator](https://flightdecide.com/tools/holding-pattern-calculator/):
  direct/teardrop/parallel entry from heading + radial + turn
  direction, AIM 70-degree sectors drawn on a compass, next steps.
- [Personal Minimums Worksheet](https://flightdecide.com/tools/personal-minimums-worksheet/):
  printable worksheet for setting ceiling/visibility/wind/performance
  minimums, based on the FAA approach.

## Pilot Guides (educational articles)

- [Guides hub](https://flightdecide.com/learn/)
- [The Go/No-Go Decision Framework](https://flightdecide.com/learn/go-no-go-decision-framework/):
  PAVE-based structure for preflight decisions, continuation-bias traps.
- [Personal Minimums](https://flightdecide.com/learn/personal-minimums/):
  how to set, adjust, and keep honest personal weather/wind minimums.
- [How to Read a TAF](https://flightdecide.com/learn/how-to-read-a-taf/):
  line-by-line TAF decoding (FM, TEMPO, BECMG, PROB30) and go/no-go use.
- [What NOTAMs to Check](https://flightdecide.com/learn/what-notams-to-check/):
  NOTAM types, a practical triage order, TFRs, and the "no NOTAMs" trap.
- [Canadian Weather Briefing](https://flightdecide.com/learn/canadian-weather-briefing/):
  plan.navcanada.ca (CFPS), FIC phone briefings (1-866-WX-BRIEF), the GFA,
  and US-vs-Canada briefing differences.
- [Canadian NOTAMs Explained](https://flightdecide.com/learn/canadian-notams/):
  ICAO format since 2019, Q-line decoding, geo-referenced filtering, CFPS
  retrieval.
- [CYA, CYR, CYD Airspace](https://flightdecide.com/learn/cya-cyr-cyd-airspace/):
  Canadian Class F special use airspace: advisory/restricted/danger entry
  rules, DAH 56-day cycle, activation by NOTAM.

## Comparisons (honest, we-build-FlightDecide disclosed)

- [Comparisons hub](https://flightdecide.com/compare/)
- [Best Preflight Briefing & Go/No-Go Apps 2026](https://flightdecide.com/compare/best-preflight-briefing-apps/):
  ranked by use case: 1800wxbrief (official, free), GoNoGo (best free),
  FlightDecide (AI second opinion vs your aircraft + minimums), PlaneWX
  (long-range planning), WeatherSpork (weather education), ForeFlight /
  Garmin Pilot (full EFBs).
- [FlightDecide vs ForeFlight](https://flightdecide.com/compare/flightdecide-vs-foreflight/):
  complement, not replacement: EFB for flying, FlightDecide for the
  go/no-go decision; many pilots run both.
- [FlightDecide vs an Official Briefing](https://flightdecide.com/compare/flightdecide-vs-official-briefing/):
  FlightDecide is NOT an official briefing; 91.103 / AC 91-92 self-brief
  context and a recommended combined workflow.

## Aircraft Performance Library (POH-digitized, source cited per page)

- [Aircraft hub](https://flightdecide.com/aircraft/): 42 GA aircraft, each
  page with V-speeds, POH cruise performance tables, fuel capacity, weights,
  and (where published) takeoff/landing distances. Trainers (Cessna
  150/152/172, Piper Cherokee/Warrior/Archer, Diamond DA20/DA40) through
  singles (182, 206, SR20/SR22/SR22T, Bonanza), twins (Baron 58, Seneca,
  Seminole, DA42/DA62, 310R), turboprops (King Air 200, 1900D) and jets
  (Citation CJ3, SF50 Vision Jet). URL pattern:
  https://flightdecide.com/aircraft/<manufacturer-model>/ (e.g.
  /aircraft/cessna-172s-skyhawk/, /aircraft/cirrus-sr22/).
- Data is approximate reference material from the FlightDecide curated
  library; the FAA-approved AFM/POH for a specific serial number governs.
